edges.reason: transfer() delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() delegates to the private _transfer routine.
transferFrom() reduces allowance through _approve.
approve() delegates to _approve.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard takes the team share.
_transferStandard reflects the fee.
_transferStandard obtains values from _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues.
_getValues reads the rate via _getRate.
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in swap.
_transfer pushes ETH to fees via sendETHToFee.
manualswap authority relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authority relies solely on msg.sender equality with _feeAddrWallet1.
openTrading calls the router addLiquidityETH.
openTrading calls the factory createPair.
openTrading is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier reading _owner.
setBots is restricted by onlyOwner reading _owner.
setCooldownEnabled is restricted by onlyOwner reading _owner.
renounceOwnership is restricted by onlyOwner reading _owner.
msg.sender becomes the from argument of transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when reducing allowance in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner recorded by approve.
msg.sender is compared with _owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is compared with _feeAddrWallet1 to authorize manualswap.
msg.sender is compared with _feeAddrWallet1 to authorize manualsend.
block.timestamp drives the cooldown window and _maxTxAmount enforcement.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline, making execution miner-dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline in openTrading.
from parameter flows into the transfer logic.
to parameter flows into the transfer logic.
amount parameter is compared to _maxTxAmount and passed downstream.
contractTokenBalance is supplied as the tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is forwarded to sendETHToFee.
manualswap obtains contractBalance from balanceOf and swaps it.
manualsend obtains contractETHBalance and sends it to fees.
swapTokensForEth forwards control and value to the external Uniswap router.
The router swap can re-enter the token transfer path through the pair.
External router call can re-enter the swap routine before inSwap is reset.
sendETHToFee performs ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
ETH is pushed to _feeAddrWallet1, an external payable address.
ETH is pushed to _feeAddrWallet2, an external payable address.
setBots writes attacker/owner supplied addresses into the bots blacklist.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag controlling transfer gates.
rAmount is divided by the current rate, sensitive to rounding and rate math.
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply, the core reflection arithmetic.
_getRValues multiplies amounts by currentRate.
_getTValues multiplies amount by fee percentages and divides by 100.
_takeTeam obtains currentRate to inflate the team share.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance.
_transferStandard debits sender and credits recipient reflection balances.
swapTokensForEth builds the swap path local array.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
createPair returns the pair assigned to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets the router used for later swaps.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: Source address buffer only meaningful inside _transfer's fee/blacklist logic.
Destination address buffer only meaningful inside _transfer's fee/blacklist logic.
Amount buffer is validated against _maxTxAmount and consumed by _transfer.
Token amount argument exists only for the router swap performed by swapTokensForEth.
Amount argument is split between the fee wallets inside sendETHToFee.
Sender buffer used solely for reflection balance bookkeeping.
Recipient buffer used solely for reflection balance bookkeeping.
Token amount buffer consumed by _getValues in _transferStandard.
Blacklist array is only iterated to write the bots mapping in setBots.
Token amount buffer feeds fee computation inside _getValues.
Sender buffer forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
Recipient buffer forwarded to _transfer from transferFrom.
Amount buffer drives both the transfer and the allowance subtraction.
Spender buffer forwarded to _approve by approve.
Allowance buffer written via _approve by approve.
Account buffer used only to read the reflection balance.
Reflection amount buffer validated and converted in tokenFromReflection.
Team token buffer converted to reflections in _takeTeam.
Reflection fee buffer subtracted from _rTotal in _reflectFee.
Token fee buffer added to _tFeeTotal in _reflectFee.
Owner buffer checked for the zero address in _approve.
Spender buffer checked for the zero address in _approve.
Allowance buffer stored in the allowance mapping by _approve.
Derived contract balance used only for the auto-swap branch of _transfer.
Derived ETH balance used only for the auto-send branch of _transfer.
Path array exists solely for the router swap call.
Loop counter exists only for the blacklist insertion loop.
Balance read exists only to be swapped by manualswap.
Balance read exists only to be forwarded to sendETHToFee by manualsend.
Rate value used only for inflating the team share in _takeTeam.
